rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the brown colour.

example.english: I want to buy the brown shirt.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 fe1 sik1 go2 gin6 seot1 saam1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese adjective for something that is brown in colour.

example.english: This brown shirt looks great on you.
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 fe1 sik1 seot1 saam1 hou2 can3 nei5
